name: Action Construction Equipment Ltd
about: Action Construction Equipment Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing and marketing of hydraulic mobile cranes, mobile tower cranes, material handling equipment like forklifts, road construction equipment like backhoe loaders, compactors, motor graders and agriculture equipment like tractors, harvesters, rotavators, etc. It was incorporated in 1995 and concluded its IPO in 2006.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is the world’s largest Pick & Carry crane manufacturer with a 63%+ market share in the Mobile cranes segment in India and a 60%+ market share in the Tower Cranes segment domestically. [1] It is also India’s leading Forklift Manufacturer with a 19% market share and captured a 10%+ market share for tractors in Assam. [2] [3]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 51.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.8%
Company's median sales growth is 17.8% of last 10 years
